119: Cross-carrier invariants:
120: 
121: 1. Full semantic identities and content digests remain separate. No equality of
122:    labels or payloads creates a join or grants authority.
123: 2. Acquired payload is distinct from a locator. Derived projections preserve
124:    parent identity, all required closure records, qualifications and boundaries.
125: 3. Every dependency-sensitive effect rechecks its exact material preconditions,
126:    policy, Product definition, method/profile and executor dependencies. It does
127:    not silently rebase on new bytes. Effects are recorded before returning.
128: 4. Admission comes from the protected selected mechanism and existing policy
129:    authority. A request's alleged grant/receipt is not trusted evidence.
130: 5. Role is startup-bound. Executive/Reviewer cannot call a candidate/work-carrier
131:    Writer operation or receive mutation authority from a role label. Automatic
132:    tool evidence stays outside the Product/worktree; it is not such a mutation.
133: 6. Receipt, evaluation, output, intended effect and observed end are independent
134:    facts. Lost response, timeout, cancellation and process exit do not alone
135:    establish external completion or rollback.
136: 7. Historical returns retain original subject, basis, predicate and verdict.
137:    Current applicability is a new check/relation. Duplicate evidence is not an
138:    additional assessment; inconsistent evidence remains visible.
139: 8. Unsupported/missing premises remain gaps. Negative reachability in incomplete
140:    coverage proves no non-influence, fit proves no attention, and a necessary
141:    condition proves no stronger claim.
142: 9. Evidence retention never creates a disposition, acceptance, release, role
143:    transition, work-state ledger or next-action grant.
